bio_en: Ales Parsamian joined the ARF in about 1894, when propagandists from the Caucasus first brought the party to Van, together with his inseparable comrades Teos and Armenak; the trio became pioneers and pillars of the party in Van. He took part in many secret ARF operations in the city, and in 1900-09 lived the fugitive life of a haiduk. In the April 1915 fighting in Van he led fighting groups with great courage. Worn down by illness and suffering, he died in Yerevan, as reported in Ashkhatank on 24 March 1918.
notes: Compiled from the archive review, 2026-10-12. Confidence: high.
